svg.title: Landings on master, cumulative, four drives
svg.desc: Each step is one gated batch landing on master. Grey bands: the loop was parked, stopped or paused.
svg.text: Landings on master over 35 days: four drives, 68 landings

rect.title: Hardening 1, paused: 10-19 23:06 to 10-20 00:15 (STOP on the operator's word ("Yes, pause the loop with the STOP file."), so that the operator could review batches 0-3; resumed on "proceed ... with the next batches")

Hardening 1, stopped by the operator: 10-20 09:32 to 10-20 11:14 (STOP for the history rewrite (commit identity), on the operator's scope-A order "fix everything, and document it honestly"; restarted on the rewritten history)
Harness, model outage park: 10-25 21:32 to 10-26 00:55 (gateway refused new connections; run 0014 waited for it ("gateway down: run 0014 waits" ... "gateway up again after 12122 s"))
Hardening 2, restart: 10-27 09:01 to 10-27 09:05 (the M1060 shakedown (`drive --once`, run 0077) ended by design; the supervisor then started the loop unit)

Hardening 2, restart: 10-28 19:38 to 10-28 19:38 (STOP for a loop restart onto the pinned c49b4270 jichi-harness (the loop process still ran 561e91b4's deleted binary); the operator: "restart the loop")
Hardening 2, model outage park: 10-31 01:02 to 10-31 04:10 (STOP to park: gateway block 1 (probe 000 01:03-04:04); resumed by park-resume.sh)
Hardening 2, model outage park: 11-02 02:22 to 11-02 05:31 (STOP to park: gateway block 2 (01:26-05:26); resumed by park-resume.sh)
Hardening 2, model outage park: 11-02 17:09 to 11-02 20:31 (STOP to park: gateway block 3 from 16:27; a workstation reboot (18:16) fell inside the park; resumed by park-resume.sh v2)

Hardening 2, paused: 11-05 03:30 to 11-05 04:19 (PAUSE (supervisor, per the operator's DH5.1 decisions) while BATCH 12 (4a1aee78) gated; restarted for fix batch 12b after the review rated M1125 WRONG)
Harness port, waiting: 11-07 07:05 to 11-07 07:15 (three quick failures in a row: waiting 10 minutes (runs died at exec, rc 127: the prompt as one argv over 128 KiB))
Harness port, waiting: 11-07 07:16 to 11-07 07:26 (three quick failures in a row: waiting 10 minutes (runs died at exec, rc 127))
Harness port, waiting: 11-07 07:27 to 11-07 07:37 (three quick failures in a row: waiting 10 minutes (runs died at exec, rc 127))
Harness port, waiting: 11-07 07:38 to 11-07 07:48 (three quick failures in a row: waiting 10 minutes (runs died at exec, rc 127))
Harness port, restart: 11-07 23:09 to 11-07 23:09 (RESTART onto the pinned a4f6305c jichi-harness (H6 + H7 harness code), on the operator's word)
Harness port, restart: 11-09 17:07 to 11-09 17:08 (RESTART onto the pinned 53a1ef4e jichi-harness (H9a + H9a1), on the operator's word)

Harness port, model outage park: 11-10 12:05 to 11-10 12:06 (the page watcher saw model calls failing for 31 minutes (10:39) and set the drive to stop after its current run; the run's own retry recovered, the run ended normally and the loop started again)

Harness port, paused: 11-12 16:31 to 11-12 19:12 (PAUSE on the operator's word ("pause after the next master lands, and discuss the next steps") after H9b landed; platform retests on the new master; resumed on the operator's word)
Harness port, paused: 11-13 14:00 to 11-13 15:25 (PAUSE at the PLAT landing for the 0.14.0 release candidate and cut (the operator's word of 11-12 18:3x))

Harness port, paused: 11-13 19:40 to 11-13 23:08 (STOP after the operator-approved short run 0047 (BATCH REL READY) while the release batch went through the gate; resumed on the operator's "option 1")
